title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 14

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. What time does the ground support equipment lesson begin?
tasks.audioText: The aviation technology lecturer will introduce ground support equipment documentation on Wednesday at twelve. Students should bring the equipment checklist and service-status form. The lesson will show how technicians identify a unit, record its condition and communicate availability.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which status documents should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The aviation technology lecturer will introduce ground support equipment documentation on Wednesday at twelve. Students should bring the equipment checklist and service-status form. The lesson will show how technicians identify a unit, record its condition and communicate availability.
options: The equipment checklist and service-status form

tasks.prompt: Ground support equipment includes vehicles and systems used to service an aircraft on the ground. Before use, equipment status and inspection information must be checked under local procedures. A service-status record identifies the unit and states whether it is available, restricted or out of service. Clear wording helps prevent use when status is uncertain. Reading 1. What should a service-status record identify?
Why is clear status wording important?
options: To prevent use when its status is uncertain

tasks.prompt: The equipment status ___ before the unit is used.
Which TWO details should be clear in a ground support equipment status record?
Could we confirm the unit's What is the best response?
options: Could we confirm the unit's service status with the responsible team before use?
I will copy an unrelated record.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of aviation ground support equipment in a logical order.
options: Record or communicate the confirmed status
Confirm availability with the responsible team
correctOrder: Confirm availability with the responsible team
Record or communicate the confirmed status

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining why ground support equipment needs clear identification and service-status records.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: content and task completion (0–2); organisation and linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2).
